in_marathi.name: Samaresh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Calmness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samaresh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sama Resh means 'Lord of Calmness' in Sanskrit and Bengali. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sama' meaning calm and 'Resh' meaning Lord. It is a name for a wise and calm-natured individual who embodies the qualities of tranquility and serenity.
